And what actually decides the rest
Re-checked across every pre-solved world when you move a dial. One shared orbital cost basis sits under all of them, so agreement across worlds does not multiply the evidence.
03 · Look inside
The machine each future runs through
Every line in the cloud above is this loop, run year by year to 2040. Four stations read out your world live as you scrub. The build half of the loop, the allocation module, the queues and the fleet, is quantified in the analysis. Every arrow crosses a one-year lag; nothing is circular.
⟲  next year's supply reads this year's decisions · one-year lag on every arrow
04 · The unit trap, self-served
What compute costs
One market price, two honest units, indexed to 2026. Per fixed unit of capability it collapses; per frontier chip of the era it does not, because each era's chip packs more capability. Flip the toggle and decide which sentence you were reading in the news.
